title.label: So much potential but so confusing

content.label: I wanted to love this app so much. But it is trying too hard to be simple and ends up being unintuitive to use. I wasted several hours over several different sessions trying to make it work for me. Just now all my tasks reprdered themselves, be darned how I had it set up. Not sure if that is an update but this is counterproductive, not helpful

title.label: Best App for ADHD, Autism, Parenting, & life

content.label:
Make routines and habits easy to develop and keep. Great for goal setting and staying focused. Easy to link with other apps. Easy for children and adults of all ages to use. 

I use it for homeschooling and work and my spiritual routine. It makes me accountable and helps me see trends or where I can improve in life. 

It has four pages of tasks ONLY and task arrangements can be changed or the page’s colors. Each task is editable. You can make ALL kinds of task to notify you or sound an alarm or open another app or track data to others. 

I really wish it had more pages. That has been something I wished for very much. Since I use it for everything. I had to simplify what task I make and only make it the major ones. But I personally have ADHD and this app helps me get three parts of my day. But with more pages I could get through my whole day.

Would really love a “One-Time Task” button so i can have my repeating tasks and one time tasks all in one spot. Complete “Call Dad” and it goes away, not repeating everyday.  I get that this app is for “streaks” but it would be a great feature.
Wonderful app, has helped me with my habits a lot

I used to love this app but one day it stopped working and when I reinstalled it to try to get it to work, the app freezes and breaks during setup. It specifically freezes when ios asks for notifications permissions so that might have something to do with this. Really wish I could use this app again, hope a solution can be found in the future

I’ve always had problems with sticking to habits in the long run, whether it be I forget about it or lose interest. But this app makes sticking to your goals fun and simple, and I almost view it like a video game! This app would have already been good enough with just marking a habit as complete, but it also has negative tasks, health tasks, timed tasks, and the ability to set a task to do multiple times a day, and much more! While some of the controls can be improved and have the ability to be changed, I think it’s a very well designed app that has a lot of utility in my daily routine.
From the well-timed notifications to the gamification of completing your goals this has helped me stay disciplined

title.label: Helped reorient my life during COVID

content.label:
I've been using this app since November 2020 and it's been an indispensible tool for me ever since. When I was forced to work from home 100% that year, I lost all sense of routine and started losing track of my health upkeep and house chores. Once I found this app and spent some time configuring it with a sustainable pattern of habits, my productivity and health issues started to dissipate and reverse. Thanks for making this app! :)

My only suggestion at this point would be to add a few more pages for monthly tasks!

title.label: Like the app, one thing though..

content.label: Pleaasssee let us add more than 6 per page. Don't know why but for some reason I think it would make a big difference for me. Or less per page. Should be able to set individual page sizes to meet needs
Essential for health nuts such as myself. I would not be shocked if Apple ends up purchasing this app for millions.

Honestly, I just switched to iPhone and I hate that so many are paid/subscription/micro transactions so I don’t really use a lot of them. This was worth it. I have a condition that makes me super forgetful and this really helps me keep track of what I haven’t done and sends me notifications. I also love the widget. Everything about it has been helpful and I am glad I made the purchase. There is a reason it is on like every list of must have apps.

The most annoying bug that made me ultimately get out of the habit of using the app is that it pauses my audio (Apple Music, audible) when marking a task complete. They may have fixed this bug once, for a minute, but it is back and has been around for a long time overall.

title.label: Absolute trash. Give me my money back.

content.label: It automatically marks days as completed streaks unless I open the app and manually change it. Which forces me to remember everything. Completely defeats the purpose of this app. No settings to change almost anything. I’m better off marking days on a calendar on my bedroom wall. Don’t apologize. Just give me my money back.

Great app! Only thing I wish it could do that it can’t is set up either/or tasks…something like either run or bike daily/yoga or Pilates, allowing the user to pivot on their fitness without ending a streak. I realize you could do exercise minutes to essentially cover this but for those of us that break that down into rings AND specific exercises it would be cool.

I would love to give this app 5 stars but there’s really bad bugs with iCloud sync across devices. Marking something as completed on one device rarely successfully syncs to other devices. The habits you’re trying to track also do not sync successfully, for example, I used to have a habit to call my dad everyday, but no matter what it keeps appearing on other devices despite having deleted it everywhere. Note I have iCloud sync turned on, plenty of storage available, and good connectivity on all devices. 

If these bugs were to be fixed I would easily give a 5 star review!
Please add a medium widget streak view, preferably like a Github contribution grid. That feature would make this app the absolute best in my book.

title.label: Love the App- widget doesn’t sync well with app and Apple Watch

content.label: Would give 5 stars if the above issue was resolved.

I’m only 3 weals into using Streaks but it is truly amazing. It really works - I’m actually accomplishing all my tasks. 

I love the colorful visuals. Super easy to set up and track.

My only suggestions - and another page of 6 tasks, add an every other week option, a quarterly option and a yearly option.

Has great sounds & graphics, and there are benefits to it’s simple design. However…  • Items marked as completed from timed reminders on the Apple Watch do not get marked as completed in the iPhone app. One has to manually open the app on the Apple Watch, navigate to the task, and mark it completed for it to be reflected on the phone app. This bug is unnecessarily inconvenient.  • Also, needs the flexibility to have tasks grouped into multiple user profiles and broader limits on the number of tasks allowed. Would be a great tool for tracking kids’ chores if this was included. Could also be used for segmenting apart business, personal, and educational tasks for those of us having to wear multiple hats.
I was confused by the behavior of the “Up Next“ function. Quentin from customer support was very helpful.

title.label: Please add this one feature from Duolingo

content.label: Amazing app overall, but I think it’s impossible to keep a perfect streak forever! I wish I could have two “misses”/“streak freezes” in a row before my streak actually breaks, and earn back a streak freeze for every 2 days I do in a row, back to a maximum of two.

I LOVE this app. But I get really down on myself when I miss a day because it feels like all progress is gone. My dream is that instead of saying “13 star” it would say 13/18 so I did the task 13 days out of 18 days where I opened the app and marked something! so at the end of the year it would say “358/365” or similar!!! That would allow me to track progress without obsessing over missing a single day!

title.label: Add Emojis & Minimal Dots Watch Face

content.label: great app but if we can add emojis instead of these flat icons. a minimal dots watch complications without the text
Please enable more than 28 characters in the habit name , or maybe add a description field for longer notes, thanks

On my forever hunt for an app that makes medication tracking flexible and seamless, because I will frequently lose track of what time or day it is, and trying to remember which of my medications I have taken that day is a challenge. Enter the idea of using NFC tags to scan medications as I open the bottle! Streaks is compatible with NFC tag scanning by way of co-programming using iPhone’s shortcuts, and as long as you have Streaks open 24/7, everything is great. Alas for me, I constantly close background apps in a quest for decent battery life and reduced visual clutter, and if Streaks is not open, the shortcut will fail to log activity into Streaks 100% of the time. Honestly I’m confused by this as 1. Streaks is more than capable of running reminders and task tracking settings within the Streaks app, with the app being closed, 2. Shortcuts are able to create entries in other apps without them being perpetually open and 3. Shortcuts has steps like “open app” available for programming, which would solve my main issue, except Streaks isn’t an option there.

Glad this app is an one time purchase vs constant subscription fees, but it doesn’t meet my needs for the singular, explicit function I bought it for. I think it’s a good app, just not for me (yet.) Hopeful in the future to see a fix or enhancement that allows an iPhone shortcut to engage with Streaks while it is not actively open.

title.label: Not functioning on Apple Vision Pro

content.label: I install the app and am greeted with an error screen. “Add tasks on iPhone, iPad or Mac. iCloud Zone does not exist.” This is not a good user experience yet sadly.

I just want to easily mark that I've done a task. I want to easily delete a task. I want to easily add a task. I am not finding anything that says in the settings add a task delete a task complete show the task is complete.where do I find this?

Fix your app that doesn’t install on Apple WatchOS 8.8 

I got this specifically to use from my watch and it doesn’t work. What a joke.

I was really excited when I bought this app. Now, I'm simply disappointed.

Completely useless user "help" documentation - it is no help in learning how to use this app.

Please don't tell me the interface is so intuitive. It is only intuitive to the designers who created the app.

I'm going to search YouTube for videos on how to use this.
Dig this app!
Habits are acquired one small streak at a time
This is the app
I love this app so much, it can really help you start and stop things like you have a goal. I also love how you can do a thing multiple times to complete it in a day. Very useful.
Why is a habit limited to only 28 letters in the name?
I do not find it user friendly. The clunkiest app ever. It is extremely counterintuitive .

This is the best habit creating app that I have found! I wish they would add reward tasks (Ie. once I finish my daily “required” tasks a “reward” task shows up… maybe watch an episode of a show or play a game of chess). It would be a great way to reinforce good habits with rewards!

I am a man who needs constant reminders to get my daily/weekly/monthly tasks done. With Streaks, I not only get the reminders, but also the consistency. I thrive on seeing my accomplishements completed. It's like lining through a task on a whiteboard, but more effective since I can carry this whiteboard anywhere. It's one of those apps that have helped (somewhat) to increase the regulariy of what I'm getting done.

title.label: Great way to monitor my tasks!

content.label: I use this everyday to guide myself thru tasks that are important to me!

Once you get used to the interface, it’s a really great app concept. I wish you could name the screens to organize different routines. And I really really wish there was a way to log more than the goal. Like I want to do 10 pushups every day, but also track the number I actually did so I can see if I should up my goal amount.

This app has changed my life - I’ve pretty much tried all of the well known habit tracking apps and this one is SO much more effective than the others. I’ve been a user experience professional for over 20 years and it makes my heart sing to find an app with such great usability. It is  dead simple to set up and a joy to use. The phone widget is the icing on the cake - the fact that I see it every time I use my phone means that it’s always top of mind. Highly recommend!
Helpful. Worth it. You can do it
Please add counting down a task as an option. (Example: start from 30 and count down to 1)

Amazing app, has been very useful in building habits. Clearly the best habit tracker. Lots of little features that are great like the automatic notifications seem to always come just at the right time for the habits. Calories, weight, exercises, app usage, all connected automatically so you don't need to manually check off. Has a pomodoro timer built in. Just really thoughtfully designed software.

title.label: Good, but stops my audio when I check off something

content.label: That’s my gripe. If I’m listening to a podcast or something, and I hit the button to log drinking water… it plays the completion sound, and my podcast stops playing. I have to go back to the Downcast app and press play again.
You can do daily, weekly, and monthly habits!! They also have a lot of cute icons for your habits!
Please fix this issue! I will complete a task and it will automatically uncomplete itself a moment later.

title.label: Streaks is an incredible and extremely well-designed app

content.label: I have been using Streaks since 2018 and it’s a remarkable app. It’s designed to perfectly balance customization and simplicity. It’s use is intuitive and it has helped me build habits and routines. I am v grateful for Streaks. Lastly, I am so glad they haven’t gone the subscription route. I’d gladly pay one-time fees for upgrades.
Two tasks disappeared yesterday and today eighteen of my twenty four are gone. I have no idea why. I’ve been using this app for years.

title.label: Used to be a great app

content.label: Used to be a great app until the syncing problems in iOS 17. The syncing problems are really bad, specially with the Apple Watch. I makes the app almost unusable. It’s a shame since this app was so simple and effective. But without the ability to sync well, what’s the point? Update: they finally fixed the issue with the Apple Watch, so updating my review away from 1 star.
